toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Oor en oor' is a calque of English 'over and over'; 'keer op keer' is the Afrikaans idiom, same word count.
toegepas.fout: 'oor en oor' copies English 'over and over'
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Keer op keer' is the natural Afrikaans idiom, has the same meaning and the same word count, and touches no protected word.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses each with its own subject and verb (plase hou aan / ander plant).
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Party plase hou ... aan' and 'ander plant ... gewasse' each have their own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma; no words are added.

toegepas.voor: Daar woon min mense en daar is
toegepas.na: Daar woon min mense, en daar is
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two full clauses (daar woon min mense / daar is min winkels).
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Daar woon min mense' and 'daar is min winkels en dienste' are two full clauses joined by 'en', so the comma is required.

toegepas.voor: groter as 'n dorpie en die huise staan
toegepas.na: groter as 'n dorpie, en die huise staan
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two full clauses (dorp is / huise staan).
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'n Dorp is groter' and 'die huise staan nader' each have their own subject and verb, so the comma is required and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: the second 'en' joins a new clause (die verkeer is), not a list item; the protected word stays intact.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
toegepas.rede_keurder: The second 'en' starts a new clause ('die verkeer is dikwels stadig') rather than a list item, the list itself keeps no comma before its 'en', and 'minibus-taxi's' stays intact.

vlae.teks: Daar woon min mense en daar is min winkels en dienste. Die mense van die dorpie en die plase rondom deel sy winkel en sy skool.
vlae.rede: 'Min winkels' (plural) is followed by 'sy winkel' (one shop); fixing it means choosing between one shop and a few, which is content, so it is flagged rather than changed.
